behaviours.title: A deposit credits the account and records a deposit entry
behaviours.given: a new Ledger with no accounts
behaviours.when: 100 is deposited to account 'a' with txnId 't1'
behaviours.then: the result is ok, balance('a') is 100 and entries('a') is a single deposit entry of 100 with txnId 't1'
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is refused because account 'a' was never opened, and the balance stays 0
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is rejected with 'unknown-account' and no entry is recorded
the deposit is accepted but recorded under kind 'credit'

behaviours.title: A deposit of 0 is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.when: 0 is deposited to account 'a' with txnId 't1'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and balance('a') is 0 with no entries
behaviours.contrary_then: the zero deposit is accepted and a deposit entry of 0 is recorded
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is accepted as a no-op with no entry

behaviours.title: A negative deposit is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and the balance stays 50
behaviours.contrary_then: the negative deposit is accepted and the balance drops to 45
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is treated as 5 and the balance becomes 55

behaviours.title: Deposit amounts are rounded to the cent, half up
behaviours.then: balance('a') is 1.01 and the deposit entry amount is 1.01
behaviours.contrary_then: the half cent is dropped and the balance is 1.00
contrary_alternatives: the amount is kept unrounded at 1.005
banker's rounding gives 1.00

behaviours.title: A deposit smaller than half a cent is accepted but credits 0
behaviours.then: the result is ok, balance('a') is 0 and a deposit entry of amount 0 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is rejected with 'amount-too-small' and no entry is recorded
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is rounded up and credits 0.01
the deposit is accepted with no entry recorded

behaviours.title: Repeating a deposit with the same txnId is accepted but credits only once
behaviours.when: 100 is deposited to 'a' again with txnId 't1'
behaviours.then: the second call returns ok, balance('a') stays 100 and there is one entry
behaviours.contrary_then: the repeat credits again and the balance becomes 200
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is rejected with 'duplicate' and the balance stays 100

behaviours.title: A txnId already used on one account blocks a deposit to another account
behaviours.then: the call returns ok but balance('b') is 0 and 'b' has no entries
behaviours.contrary_then: txnIds are per account, so 'b' is credited 50
contrary_alternatives: the call is rejected with 'duplicate' and 'b' stays at 0

behaviours.title: An invalid amount is reported even when the txnId was already used
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the duplicate txnId is checked first and the call returns ok
contrary_alternatives: the call is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: An account that was never opened reads as balance 0 with no entries
behaviours.then: balance is 0 and entries is an empty list
behaviours.contrary_then: reading an unknown account gives an undefined balance
contrary_alternatives: reading an unknown account throws an error

behaviours.title: Opening an existing account does not reset it
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 50 after a deposit with txnId 't1'
behaviours.then: balance('a') stays 50 and the deposit entry is still there
behaviours.contrary_then: re-opening resets the account to balance 0 with no entries
contrary_alternatives: re-opening throws an 'account exists' error

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit is converted at the given rate and recorded as a deposit
behaviours.then: the result is ok, balance('a') is 15 and the entry is a deposit of 15
behaviours.contrary_then: the unconverted amount 10 is credited
contrary_alternatives: the amount is divided by the rate and 6.67 is credited
the entry kind is a separate 'foreign-deposit'

behaviours.title: A converted foreign amount is rounded to the cent, half up
behaviours.then: balance('a') is 0.13
behaviours.contrary_then: the half cent is dropped and the balance is 0.12
contrary_alternatives: the unrounded 0.125 is credited

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit with rate 0 is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and balance('a') is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is accepted and credits 0
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is rejected with 'amount-too-small'
a rate of 0 is treated as 1 and 10 is credited

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit with amount 0 or a negative rate is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: both return { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and balance('a') is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the negative rate is accepted and the call returns ok
contrary_alternatives: the negative rate is rejected with 'amount-too-small'

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit that converts to less than half a cent is rejected as amount-too-small
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'amount-too-small' }, balance('a') is 0 and entries('a') is empty
behaviours.contrary_then: the deposit is accepted and a deposit entry of 0 is recorded
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is rounded up and credits 0.01

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit converting to exactly half a cent rounds up to 0.01 and is accepted
behaviours.then: the result is ok and balance('a') is 0.01
behaviours.contrary_then: the half cent rounds down to 0 and the deposit is rejected as amount-too-small
contrary_alternatives: the deposit is accepted but credits 0

behaviours.title: A rejected too-small foreign deposit does not use up its txnId
behaviours.then: it is credited and balance('a') is 10
behaviours.contrary_then: the txnId is treated as already used and the balance stays 0
contrary_alternatives: the retry is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: A foreign deposit with an already used txnId returns ok before the too-small check
behaviours.then: the result is ok and balance('a') stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the call is rejected as amount-too-small
contrary_alternatives: the call is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Repeating a foreign deposit with the same txnId credits only once
behaviours.then: it returns ok and balance('a') stays 15
behaviours.contrary_then: the repeat credits again and the balance becomes 30
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: A withdrawal is charged a 1% fee, recorded together with the amount
behaviours.then: the result is ok, balance('a') is 99 and the withdrawal entry amount is 101
behaviours.contrary_then: no fee is charged and the balance is 100
contrary_alternatives: the fee is recorded as a separate entry of 1 and the withdrawal entry is 100
the withdrawal is rejected

behaviours.title: The withdrawal fee is at least 0.50
behaviours.then: the fee charged is 0.50 and balance('a') is 89.5
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee is 1% (0.10) and the balance is 89.9
contrary_alternatives: there is no minimum and the balance is 89.9
a flat 0.50 is added to the 1% and the balance is 89.4

behaviours.title: The 1% withdrawal fee is rounded up to the next cent
behaviours.then: the fee is 0.51 and balance('a') is 49.48
behaviours.contrary_then: the fee is rounded to 0.50 and the balance is 49.49
contrary_alternatives: the fee is kept fractional and the balance is 49.4899

behaviours.title: A withdrawal fee above the minimum is exactly 1% with nothing added
behaviours.then: the fee is 0.60 and balance('a') is 39.4
behaviours.contrary_then: the minimum fee 0.50 is charged instead and the balance is 39.5
contrary_alternatives: the minimum is added on top, the fee is 1.10 and the balance is 38.9

behaviours.title: The withdrawal fee is capped at 25
behaviours.then: the fee is 25 and balance('a') is 6975
behaviours.contrary_then: there is no cap, the fee is 30 and the balance is 6970
contrary_alternatives: the cap is 50 and the balance is 6970

behaviours.title: A withdrawal must leave room for the fee
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' } and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted because the amount itself equals the balance
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes -1
the fee is waived and the balance becomes 0

behaviours.title: A withdrawal that uses the balance exactly, fee included, is accepted
behaviours.then: the result is ok and balance('a') is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected as insufficient-funds because it would empty the account
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is rejected because some minimum balance must remain

behaviours.title: A withdrawal from an account that was never opened is rejected as insufficient-funds
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' } and balance('x') is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected with 'unknown-account'
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes -1.50

behaviours.title: A withdrawal of 0 is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and the balance stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the minimum fee 0.50 is charged, leaving 99.5
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is accepted as a no-op

behaviours.title: Repeating a withdrawal with the same txnId debits only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 200 and 100 withdrawn with txnId 'w1' (balance 99)
behaviours.then: the call returns ok and balance('a') stays 99
behaviours.contrary_then: the repeat debits again and the balance becomes -2 or is refused for funds
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: A withdrawal reusing a deposit's txnId is silently ignored
behaviours.then: the call returns ok and balance('a') stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: txnIds are tracked per operation type, so 50.50 is debited and the balance is 49.5
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Withdrawing exactly the daily limit of 5000 is accepted; the fee does not count towards it
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 10000 with no withdrawals yet
behaviours.then: the result is ok and balance('a') is 4975
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is rejected with 'daily-limit' because 5000 plus the fee exceeds 5000
contrary_alternatives: the limit is exclusive and 5000 is rejected with 'daily-limit'

behaviours.title: A single withdrawal one cent over the daily limit is rejected
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 10000 with no withdrawals yet
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'daily-limit' } and the balance stays 10000
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes 4974.99
contrary_alternatives: only 5000 is paid out and the rest is refused

behaviours.title: The daily limit counts all earlier withdrawals from the account
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 10000, from which 3000 was withdrawn (balance 6975)
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'daily-limit' } and the balance stays 6975
behaviours.contrary_then: each withdrawal is checked on its own, so it is accepted and the balance becomes 4954.99
contrary_alternatives: the earlier fee is also counted and even 2000 would be refused

behaviours.title: Once 5000 has been withdrawn, even 1 more is refused; the allowance never resets
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 10000, from which 5000 was withdrawn (balance 4975)
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'daily-limit' } and the balance stays 4975
behaviours.contrary_then: the withdrawal is accepted and the balance becomes 4973.5
contrary_alternatives: the allowance resets on a new calendar day and the withdrawal is accepted

behaviours.title: A withdrawal refused for the daily limit does not use up any allowance
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 10000; a withdrawal of 5000.01 was refused for daily-limit
behaviours.then: the result is ok and balance('a') is 4975
behaviours.contrary_then: the refused attempt was counted, so 5000 is also refused with 'daily-limit'
contrary_alternatives: the account is blocked for the day after a refused withdrawal

behaviours.title: The daily limit is tracked per account
behaviours.given: accounts 'a' and 'b' each holding 10000; 5000 already withdrawn from 'a'
behaviours.then: the result is ok and balance('b') is 4975
behaviours.contrary_then: the limit is shared across accounts and 'b' is refused with 'daily-limit'
contrary_alternatives: the limit is per ledger and 'b' stays at 10000

behaviours.title: Insufficient funds is reported before the daily limit
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the daily limit is checked first and the reason is 'daily-limit'
contrary_alternatives: the withdrawal is accepted up to the balance

behaviours.title: A withdrawal refused for funds can be retried with the same txnId
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 100; withdrawing 200 with txnId 'w1' was refused; then 500 more is deposited (balance 600)
behaviours.then: the result is ok and balance('a') is 398
behaviours.contrary_then: the txnId was used up by the refused attempt, so nothing is debited and the balance stays 600
contrary_alternatives: the retry is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: A transfer of the whole balance moves it with no fee
behaviours.when: 100 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txnId 'x1'
behaviours.then: the result is ok, 'a' is 0, 'b' is 100, 'a' has a transfer-out entry of 100 and 'b' a transfer-in entry of 100
behaviours.contrary_then: a 1% fee applies and the transfer is refused as insufficient-funds
contrary_alternatives: a fee is charged and 'b' receives 99

behaviours.title: A transfer one cent over the balance is refused
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' }, 'a' stays 100 and 'b' stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer goes through and 'a' becomes -0.01
contrary_alternatives: only the available 100 is transferred

behaviours.title: A transfer of a negative amount is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and 'b' stays 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer runs in reverse and is refused as insufficient-funds for 'b'
contrary_alternatives: the transfer goes through and 'a' becomes 110

behaviours.title: Repeating a transfer with the same txnId moves money only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 100 and 30 transferred to 'b' with txnId 'x1'
behaviours.when: the same transfer of 30 with txnId 'x1' is repeated
behaviours.then: the call returns ok, 'a' stays 70 and 'b' stays 30
behaviours.contrary_then: the repeat moves money again, leaving 'a' at 40 and 'b' at 60
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: A transfer of less than half a cent succeeds even from an empty account and records zero entries
behaviours.given: a new Ledger with no money anywhere
behaviours.when: 0.004 is transferred from 'a' to 'b' with txnId 'x1'
behaviours.then: the result is ok, both balances are 0, 'a' has a transfer-out entry of 0 and 'b' a transfer-in entry of 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the transfer is refused as insufficient-funds
contrary_alternatives: the transfer is rejected with 'amount-too-small'
it is rounded up and refused because 'a' has no 0.01

behaviours.title: A transfer to the same account leaves the balance unchanged but records both legs
behaviours.when: 50 is transferred from 'a' to 'a' with txnId 'x1'
behaviours.then: the result is ok, balance('a') stays 100 and entries('a') ends with transfer-out 50 then transfer-in 50
behaviours.contrary_then: self-transfers are rejected and no entries are added
contrary_alternatives: the self-transfer is accepted as a no-op with no entries

behaviours.title: A split that does not divide evenly gives the extra cent to the first recipient
behaviours.when: 100 is split from 'a' to ['b', 'c', 'd'] with txnId 's1'
behaviours.then: 'b' gets 33.34, 'c' and 'd' get 33.33 each, and 'a' is 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the extra cent goes to the last recipient: 'b' 33.33, 'd' 33.34
contrary_alternatives: the extra cent stays with 'a' and every recipient gets 33.33
the split is refused because 100 does not divide by 3

behaviours.title: With two leftover cents, the first two recipients each get one
behaviours.then: 'b' gets 0.02, 'c' gets 0.02, 'd' gets 0.01 and 'a' is 0.95
behaviours.contrary_then: the first recipient takes both leftover cents: 'b' 0.03, 'c' 0.01, 'd' 0.01
contrary_alternatives: the leftover cents go to the last recipients: 'b' 0.01, 'c' 0.02, 'd' 0.02

behaviours.title: A split with no recipients is rejected as no-recipients
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'no-recipients' } and 'a' stays 100
behaviours.contrary_then: the split is accepted and 10 is debited from 'a' with nobody credited
contrary_alternatives: the split is accepted as a no-op

behaviours.title: A split of 0 with no recipients reports invalid-amount first
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the empty recipient list is checked first and the reason is 'no-recipients'
contrary_alternatives: the split is accepted as a no-op

behaviours.title: A split with no recipients is rejected even if its txnId was already used
behaviours.when: 10 is split from 'a' to [] with txnId 't1'
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'no-recipients' }
behaviours.contrary_then: the duplicate txnId is checked first and the call returns ok
contrary_alternatives: the call is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: Repeating a split with the same txnId pays out only once
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 100 and 10 split to ['b', 'c'] with txnId 's1'
behaviours.when: the same split is repeated with txnId 's1'
behaviours.then: it returns ok, 'a' stays 90 and 'b' stays 5
behaviours.contrary_then: the split runs again, leaving 'a' at 80 and 'b' at 10
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is rejected with 'duplicate'

behaviours.title: A split one cent over the balance is refused
behaviours.then: the result is { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-funds' }, 'a' stays 10 and 'b' and 'c' stay 0
behaviours.contrary_then: the split goes through and 'a' becomes -0.01
contrary_alternatives: only the available 10 is split, 5 each

behaviours.title: A split of exactly the whole balance is accepted
behaviours.then: the result is ok, 'a' is 0, 'b' and 'c' are 5 each
behaviours.contrary_then: the split is refused as insufficient-funds because it empties the account
contrary_alternatives: a split fee applies and the split is refused

behaviours.title: A recipient listed twice receives two shares
behaviours.when: 1 is split from 'a' to ['b', 'b'] with txnId 's1'
behaviours.then: 'b' receives 1 in total, recorded as two split-in entries of 0.5
behaviours.contrary_then: duplicates are merged and 'b' receives a single share of 0.5
contrary_alternatives: the split is rejected because of duplicate recipients

behaviours.title: Interest uses a 365-day year: 5% for 365 days on 1000 credits 50
behaviours.then: the result is ok, balance('a') is 1050 and an interest entry of 50 is recorded
behaviours.contrary_then: a 360-day year is used and 50.69 is credited, giving 1050.69
contrary_alternatives: the rate is taken as a fraction and 5000 is credited

behaviours.title: Interest is rounded down to the cent
behaviours.then: 4.10 is credited and balance('a') is 1004.1
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is rounded to nearest, 4.11 is credited and the balance is 1004.11
contrary_alternatives: interest is kept fractional

behaviours.title: Interest that works out to exactly one whole amount is credited in full
behaviours.then: 1.00 is credited and balance('a') is 74
behaviours.contrary_then: a cent is lost to rounding and the balance is 73.99
contrary_alternatives: a 360-day year is used and the balance is 74.01

behaviours.title: Interest below one cent returns ok, credits nothing and leaves the txnId unused
behaviours.given: account 'a' holding 1; applyInterest('a', 1, 1, 'i1') returned ok (interest under one cent)
behaviours.when: 5 is deposited to 'a' with the same txnId 'i1'
behaviours.then: the interest call added no entry, and the deposit is credited so balance('a') is 6
behaviours.contrary_then: the interest call used up txnId 'i1', so the deposit is ignored and the balance stays 1
contrary_alternatives: the interest call is rejected with 'amount-too-small'
a zero interest entry is recorded

behaviours.title: Interest with a rate of 0 or 0 days is rejected as invalid-amount
behaviours.then: both return { ok: false, reason: 'invalid-amount' } and the balance stays 1000
behaviours.contrary_then: both calls return ok with nothing credited
contrary_alternatives: 0 days is treated as one full year and 50 is credited

behaviours.title: Repeating interest with the same txnId credits only once
behaviours.then: it returns ok and balance('a') stays 1050
behaviours.contrary_then: interest is credited again on the new balance and the balance becomes 1102.5
contrary_alternatives: the repeat is rejected with 'duplicate'
